objective: Prove from the future Ascend-C candidate kernel source that every source read and every output write the candidate can issue for a valid invocation lies inside the supplied source W*H logical region and the H*P output buffer, explicitly including configurations where P > W.
observation: The submitted Ascend-C candidate source artifact's loop/tile bounds and its source-index and destination-index expressions, consumed by reading the candidate kernel file.
pass_condition: Accept only when every reachable access is provably in bounds: the source offset is always in [0, W*H) for all valid x, y, shiftX, shiftY (for example floor_mod(x+shiftX, W) + W*floor_mod(y+shiftY, H), or an equivalent integer expression), and the destination offset is always in [0, H*P) (for example y*P + x with 0 <= x < W and 0 <= y < H, or any other expression whose value is always within [0, H*P)). Reject if any reachable path can compute a negative source/destination offset, a source offset >= W*H, or a destination offset >= H*P, including when P > W.
setup: Read the candidate artifact that implements the migrated shiftPitchLinear kernel. Locate the logical-coordinate loops or tiles and expand any vectorized/tiled access back to individual logical (x,y) elements. Record the exact source-index expression (or equivalent address arithmetic) and destination-index expression used by each access, including any guards or modulo operations.
